summary_1line: Valmiki, through divine vision, foresees Rama’s entire life and outlines the major events that his epic poem will recount.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sage Valmiki sits on kusha grass facing east in deep meditation as the divine vision of Rama’s life unfolds before him.
Hanuman stands atop a mountain and launches into a colossal leap across the ocean toward Lanka.
Rama aims his bow on the battlefield as Ravana, crowned and many-armed, stands in his war chariot amid the chaos of battle.
